sn42.7:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nālandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
sn42.7:1.2: atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.7:1.5: atha kiñcarahi bhante bhagavā ekaccānaṃ sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, ekaccānaṃ no tathā sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ desetīti.
sn42.7:1.6: tena hi gāmaṇi, taṃ yevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
sn42.7:1.7: taṃ kimmaññasi gāmaṇi kassakassa gahapatino tīṇi khettāni: ekaṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ, ekaṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ, ekaṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ ūsaraṃ pāpabhūmi.
sn42.7:1.8: taṃ kimmaññasi gāmaṇi asu kassako gahapati bījāni patiṭṭhāpetukāmo kattha paṭhamaṃ patiṭṭhāpeyya, yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ ūsaraṃ pāpabhūminti.
sn42.7:1.9: asu bhante kassako gahapati bījāni patiṭṭhāpetukāmo yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ tattha patiṭṭhāpeyya. tattha patiṭṭhāpetvā yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ tattha patiṭṭhāpeyya. tattha patiṭṭhāpetvā yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ ūsaraṃ pāpabhūmi tattha patiṭṭhāpeyyapi, nopi patiṭṭhāpeyya.
sn42.7:2.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ, evameva mayhaṃ bhikkhubhikkhuniyo.
sn42.7:2.2: tesāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:2.4: ete hi gāmaṇi, maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:2.5: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi, yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ, evameva mayhaṃ upāsakaupāsikāyo.
sn42.7:2.6: tesampahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ, sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:2.8: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:2.9: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi, yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ ūsaraṃ pāpabhūmi. evameva mayhaṃ aññatitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paribbājakā.
sn42.7:2.10: tesampahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:2.12: appevanāma ekapadampi ājāneyyuṃ, taṃ nesaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
sn42.7:3.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi, purisassa tayo udakamaṇikā, eko udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī aparihārī, eko udakamaṇiko acchiddo hārī parihārī, eko udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārī.
sn42.7:3.2: taṃ kimmaññasi gāmaṇi asu puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitukāmo kattha paṭhamaṃ nikkhipeyya yo vā so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī parihārī, yo vā so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hārī parihārī, yo vā so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārīti.
sn42.7:3.3: asu bhante puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitukāmo yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī aparihārī tattha nikkhipeyya, tattha nikkhipitvā yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hārī parihārī tattha nikkhipeyya, tattha nikkhipitvā yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārī tattha nikkhipeyyāpi nopi nikkhipeyya.
sn42.7:4.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī aparihārī, evameva mayhaṃ bhikkhubhikkhuniyo.
sn42.7:4.2: tesāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:4.4: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:4.5: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hārī parihārī, evameva mayhaṃ upāsakaupāsikāyo.
sn42.7:4.6: tesampahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:4.8: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:4.9: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārī, evameva mayhaṃ aññatitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakā.
sn42.7:4.10: tesampahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:4.12: appevanāma ekapadampi ājāneyyuṃ, taṃ nesaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn42.7:5.1: evaṃ vutte asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
